sourceNote: 20 packs x 10 cards. Site sample: 960 BOX. Per box: SAR ~20%; 3 AR GUARANTEED; SR ~80% (60 Pokemon + 20 Trainer); UR ~10%. The box guarantee is 'one SR-or-higher', which spans three tiers and cannot be expressed as a single-tier floor — omitted. RR is not tallied by the source and is omitted (conservative). Rates come from ポケゲトちゃんねる (pokemon-infomation.com), which aggregates real box-opening tallies from card shops and individuals — the closest thing Japanese sets have to a primary study, since neither The Pokemon Company nor any English source publishes Japanese odds. Confidence is MEDIUM: the samples are large (hundreds to thousands of boxes) and the methodology is consistent across sets, but the underlying tallies are not independently auditable. Per-pack probabilities are the site's per-BOX figures divided by the box's pack count, which is separately sourced. NOTE ON GUARANTEES: the per-box guarantees (1 SAR/box on High Class, 3 AR/box, 1 ACE/box etc.) are folded into the slot rates above rather than modelled as engine floors — a floor attaches to a PRODUCT, so a single-pack product would inherit the whole box's guarantee and read absurdly positive. The rates are per-box tallies divided by pack count, so a box's EV already reflects every guarantee.
